title: Midpoint nudge: one harness message at half the response budget when no source file is edited
hypothesis: On card 007's evolution set, where 3 of 8 rejections ran out of responses without an edit, one fixed harness message after half the budget without a source edit makes the model commit to a cause and edit, so fewer runs end at the budget without an edit; runs that edit earlier never see it, so the solved-twice tasks are unaffected.

prerequisites.text: midpoint nudge implemented and unit-tested on wt/treatments (tests/test_midpoint_nudge.py)
owner approval recorded in the markdown card (then set status to running) (owner, in session 2026-09-28: 'you can continue... implementing those'; sequence approved)

arms.name: incumbent
arms.note: Card 007's incumbent arm (runner v8, claude-cli adapter v2, repeat guard off) with the model pinned by full ID: claude-sonnet-5 (2026-09-30), not the alias 'sonnet', which CLI 2.1.286 resolved to claude-sonnet-5-5. The model ID is a hash input, so its planned hash per task differs from card 007's (which ran on the alias) and equals card 007's routing with only the model changed.

arms.name: midpoint-nudge
arms.note: Card 007's incumbent arm, model pinned to claude-sonnet-5, plus --nudge midpoint. The flag is a runner treatment (not a toolset or policy version); run_card.py hashes it from extra_args with the runner's own treatments_from_args, so the planned hash is the one the runner records.

evolution.note: Card 007's evolution set: the two contrastive tasks (001, 022) and the three negative tasks with a fixable mechanism (032, 057, 061).

efficiency.note: Solved twice in card 007, for the efficiency measure (responses and active seconds per run). As listed by the owner; by card 007 wall time the three fastest are 034, 025 and 044 (040 is fifth).

controls.note: Scripted gold/noop controls under the treatment arm, before any model run.

campaign.note: 32 runs x 24 attempts = 768 planned, plus room for 5 retried runs. CLI on the subscription: no monetary cap, billing recorded as unknown.

stop_rules.repeat_rule: The markdown asks for the repeat flag to be recorded while the run continues. run_pilot.py records the flag only with --stop-on-repeats, which also stops the run, so this card runs without the guard and repeat_flags are derived from the transcripts afterwards (S6b).
manual: Evaluator leakage, evidence loss, or authority escape stops the campaign (run_card.py detects evidence loss and protocol drift; leakage and escape need trajectory review).
A symlink created by a run command is unreadable on the Windows host and ends the campaign as evidence loss; resume reruns the interrupted task.
Do not change the treatment's text or parameters during the card; a change is a new version and a new card.
Stop if a treatment run carries more than one harness_message event (the nudge fires at most once by construction).

decision_rule: Mechanism check, not a promotion (held-in tasks, 16 paired units per arm). Report per arm and set: runs where the nudge fired, the response of the first edit after it and whether it touched the gold file, runs ending at the budget without an edit, and acceptance. Earn a held-out card only if no accepted run is lost on the efficiency set and fewer evolution-set runs end at the budget without an edit than under the incumbent; otherwise reject and log.
notes: Runs are named c014-<task>-r<n>-<arm>; one runner invocation per task, rollout and arm, with --max-total-calls 24.
Arm order is seeded per unit (block, task, rollout), so a task's two rollouts can run the arms in different orders; every unit runs both arms.

The incumbent arm is card 007's with the model pinned to claude-sonnet-5. Before the pin (alias 'sonnet') its planned hash per task equaled card 007's (for example b0fda8c921ad for sqlparse-mut-001 on a CRLF checkout); the full model ID is a hash input, so it no longer does.
Model pinned by full ID (claude-sonnet-5, 2026-09-30) after alias drift: CLI 2.1.286 resolved the alias 'sonnet' to claude-sonnet-5-5, while c007/c013/c018 ran on claude-sonnet-5.
The treatment enters the protocol hash only through the runner's 'treatments' record; RUNNER_VERSION stays 8.
